author: mark
text:
scaffold: rust crate with makefile and precommit hook

Initialize the repo as a Rust library crate with cargo init. Add a
Makefile exposing build/test/coverage/lint/fmt/install-hooks/ci
targets, using cargo-tarpaulin for coverage with --fail-under 100.

Add .githooks/pre-commit that enforces three rules:
  1. No direct commits to main/master. Squash-merges from bl review
     are detected via MERGE_MSG/SQUASH_MSG and permitted.
  2. No source file over 300 lines (docs/config exempt).
  3. 100% line coverage via cargo tarpaulin.

'make install-hooks' points core.hooksPath at .githooks so the hook
ships with the repo rather than living in .git/. README documents
setup, build targets, the bl-based workflow, and the hook rules.
